name: Platform Developer
summary: Integrates fail-closed authorization defaults into platform services.
description: Wires core.authorize into platform APIs so unmatched requests deny when default_effect is deny. Relies on no_matching_rule outcomes to keep new endpoints closed until explicit policy is added.

distinguished_from.how: Integrates the capability into services; does not own host/runtime invalid-policy failure modes.
Works server-side on platform services, not client-facing structured error mapping.
